Trump calls China talks a success (Korea Times)

cards.body: Late Friday, missiles hit a restaurant car park, then drones hit rescuers. Two killed, 42 hurt, four children.
cards.headline: Double-tap strike kills two in Kryvyi Rih

cards.body: Rutte visits Poland after two Russian missiles and a drone came down on Friday. Warsaw calls it a provocation.
cards.headline: NATO chief heads to Warsaw today

cards.body: “I am not rushing into any decision,” Trump says of new Iran strikes. Israel’s envoy warns it may “go it alone”.
cards.headline: Trump puts Iran call off to 2027

cards.body: At 19:24 CET, BepiColombo fires its thrusters for 37 minutes to enter Mercury orbit after an eight-year trip.
cards.headline: Mercury capture tonight

cards.body: George Russell tops final practice at 1:34.041; qualifying runs at 04:00 UTC. Antonelli leads the title by 111 points.
cards.headline: Russell fastest before qualifying

cards.body: Alcaraz faces Shelton and Zverev meets Medvedev today. Alcaraz beat Cobolli 6-4, 6-1 on Friday, a 12th straight win.
cards.headline: Semifinals set in Turin

cards.body: Copenhagen said on Friday it is expelling Moscow’s defence attaché over a plot to kill rapper Kyivstoner.
cards.headline: Denmark expels Russian attaché

cards.body: The coalition struck Hodeidah after downing three Houthi missiles over Riyadh. The Houthis say 41 were killed.
cards.headline: Coalition hits Hodeidah port

cards.body: Gold fell almost 4% on Friday, a 9.4% weekly loss. Bitcoin is down about 24% over the month.
cards.headline: Gold sinks to a 14-month low

cards.body: The cyclone weakened after Friday’s landfall near Gopalpur. 370,000 were evacuated; Patrapur saw 209 mm of rain.
cards.headline: Akvan’s rains linger on

date_check: Left out as other days’ news: Akvan’s landfall, the Poland missiles, Kyiv’s bridges, the UK–EU deal, the cancer-pill results (Fri 20 Nov); the Myanmar ruling, Shenzhen summit, Fiona’s death, GTA VI (Thu 19 Nov); Yongbyon (Wed 18 Nov). Not yet known: F1 qualifying, the BepiColombo burn, the ATP semifinals, any COP31 deal.
footer: Every story here happened, or was first reported, on Saturday 21 November 2026. Sources: USGS · AFP · Reuters · AP · Kyiv Independent · ESA · ATP · FMC · UKMTO · market data. Original drawings.

leads.body: A magnitude 6.7 earthquake struck central Peru at 00:09 UTC, 30 km from Junín and 129 km deep. Tremors shook the capital; no deaths or serious damage were reported.
leads.headline: M6.7 quake shakes Peru, felt in Lima

leads.body: The S&P 500 fell 3.7% on Friday into correction territory and the Nasdaq lost 5.3% as Nvidia sank 14%. It is Wall Street’s worst week since Covid.
leads.headline: Wall Street slides into correction

leads.body: Climate talks slipped past Friday’s deadline with no agreement. A third draft is due on Saturday morning; the text drops fossil fuels and the $120bn aid figure.
leads.headline: COP31 runs into overtime, no deal
